_about: VoltCap defect database (tools/qa). status: open | fixed (code changed, compiled) | verified (re-run on device shows it gone) | wontfix | suspect (needs evidence). Add one entry per defect; never delete — mark it.

defects.title: New category's row drawn in place for a frame on L2/R2, then jumps aside and slides in

defects.root_cause: HomeExtras.categorySlide: LaunchedEffect(tick) snapped the slide to its start only after the frame where the category changed (and then waited two more frames) — those frames drew the new row at rest, full strength.
defects.fix: graphicsLayer draws the slide's start position while the effect hasn't caught up with the tick (as StyleCrossMenu update 166).
defects.check: home_nav scenario: no transient at the R2/L2 frames; static rule SNAP-ANIMATE

defects.title: Idle (calm, 35 s untouched) still draws ~32 fps with 31-45 % janky frames — explained

defects.note: pass 3: the background is 'Art + videos': the game's clip plays behind the row (frame-diff heatmap of a 4 s idle recording: the whole backdrop changes, ~30 fps; churn shows only the clip's clock). defects.title: Template pictures (case / cartridge / box frames, masks, spines) decoded again on the main thread for every card that came on screen
defects.found: pass 2 atrace T1: decodeBitmap 45 ms inside Compose:recompose
defects.fix: cachedImageResource(): one decode per app run, LRU-bounded at 64 MB; traced as VC:resDecode
defects.check: atrace of a category switch: VC:resDecode only on the first appearance of each template
defects.note: cold-start traces T4/T5: no VC:resDecode on the main thread in the tested categories (the templates may simply not be used there) — fix kept, effect unproven

defects.title: Cold start: first frame 830-880 ms; the main thread opens 3 encrypted credential stores (314 ms) behind the prewarm thread
defects.found: traces T3-T5 (VC:secureOpen:tgdb/screenscraper/rawg on the main thread, LauncherViewModel init)
defects.partial: SecureStore: an already-open store is returned without the lock (compiled, installed)
defects.next: build the first LauncherUiState without the *Connected flags and fill them from IO (behaviour change — needs a careful check of what reads them)
defects.note: pass 3 (QaSampler stacks): LauncherViewModel's constructor opens TgdbKeyStore / ScreenScraperStore (CS1: 68 + 203 ms). Tried: prewarm in the ViewModel's order (CS2: worse, 324 ms spread over 5 stores), stores opened in parallel (CS3: 260 ms) — the Keystore itself is the bottleneck, both reverted. Real fix = the first UI state without the *Connected flags, filled from IO; held back: startup auto-scrape reads metadataReady once (VM :5980, :6743) and would skip a run.

defects.title: One 47-58 ms main-thread decodeBitmap inside a recomposition the first time 'Nintendo 3DS' shows after a cold start
defects.found: T3/T4/T5; not imageResource / painterResource (ResImages), PlatformLogos or PackSpines (instrumented: VC:resDecode / VC:logoDecode / VC:spineDecode never fire)
defects.next: sampling profile (am profile) around the first 3DS category switch
defects.root_cause: second screen: MediaInspectView.secondCasePiece → CustomPieceTones.of → CartShells.packColour → CustomPieceTones.toneOfFile → BitmapFactory.decodeFile of your pack's cartridge picture, on the main thread in composition, the first time a pack cartridge shows after each start (found with QaSampler + retrace.py, coldsample CS1)
defects.fix: the tone is read once ever and kept in files/piece_tones.txt (path, size, date → colour); restored on a background thread at start
defects.verified: coldsample CS2 / CS3 (cold starts, same category switches): 0 main-thread decodes (CS1: 1, 47-58 ms)

defects.title: Carousel (all carousel views, e.g. STACKS with Carousel on): every game re-composed every frame of a glide
defects.found: atrace TS (STACKS): 35–46 ms frames, ~24 CarouselArt + ~190 recompose scopes in a step frame; QaInval CH/CH3: ~1,000 CarItem invalidations/s, all by one DerivedSnapshotState (mapping m1431: ao0) whose value stayed false; CarRun (item body re-runs) ≈ 1,000/s with no input changed
defects.root_cause: CarouselItem read turnedFar (derivedStateOf over the item's moving place) in composition; it is re-evaluated every glide frame and each evaluation re-ran the whole item although the answer stayed false (ARCADE's derivedStateOf over its glide does NOT do this — checked, CH4 — so it is specific to this derived state, not derivedStateOf in general).
defects.fix: turnedFar is a plain mutableState set from snapshotFlow only when the answer changes (initial value computed synchronously).
defects.check: lchurn STACKS: CarRun ~50/s (was ~1,000/s); layouts.sh STACKS janky 26.6% → 22.7%, p90 42 → 32 ms, p99 85 → 77 ms
